mission.title: ...There Is a Key
mission.description: Learn where Jane the Ripper is selling the key, eliminate her buyer, and find out what happened at her hideout.

phase.briefing:
Jane the Ripper. Leader of the Slashers, in Camon Heights. You have to be careful dealing with them... they have this whole disturbing family thing going. It's creepy, it really is.
Go talk to Jacqueline. She'll get you more information.

enter.say: I guess Jacqueline is a Merovingian program working undercover in the Slashers. Nothing like some inside information to make a job go easier!

done.say:
So... the boss wants to know about the key, huh? I hope he's gonna make it worth my while. You know how long I've been stuck with these losers?
Oh yeah, the key. I heard Jane was lookin' to flip it for a profit. In fact, she's already got a buyer lined up: Serpentis. Better get to Jane fast if you really want that key.
So, what's this info worth to the boss? Huh? Watcha lookin' at? You want a piece of me? Huh?

phase.briefing:
So, Jane thinks she's going to sell the key to Serpentis? We could try to discourage her... but you know, it would be so much easier with the other buyer out of the way.
Find out where this Serpentis is. I want him out of the picture.

enter.say: In case you're wondering, I'm sending you to Ehrsson. He knows most of what goes on around Camon Heights. He should know where Serpentis is.

talk.say:
So you want to track down Serpentis? I simply can't imagine why. Such a dreadful bore.
Oh, all right, I'll give your operator his location.

phase.briefing: Well, that was easy enough. Now go snuff out Serpentis before he can buy this thing out from under us.

enter.say: Serpentis is on site here. Move in, eliminate him, and get out. There's a key with your name on it in Jane's hands.

done.say: Okay, Serpentis's down. Now get out of there -- even with this buyer gone, that key's still got to be a hot item.

near.say: What the hell do you think you're doing here? Guards!

phase.briefing:
Ah, very nicely done, {player}. Maybe you're not destined to be a lackey forever... but it's doubtful.
Now get over to Jane's location. Persuade her by any means necessary... that key will be ours.

enter.say: I'm reading something funny in the code stream. Keep your eyes open.
Damn! Dead Slashers, no Jane... check around and see if you can find anything interesting in here.

objective.text: Search Jane's place for anything interesting

done.say: Bingo! Get that CD to a hardline and we'll let Flood sort this out.

objective.text: Upload the Data CD at a hardline

mission.finish:
The data is coming through now. Let's see... it's... a porn collection?!
{player}, this may be a new low for you. I mean really--
No, wait, there appears to be another layer of encryption here. I'm going to have my people look into this. Keep in touch, pervert.
